scope_guards: SPZ travel-time zones are modelled screening extents and are not measured pollutant travel times for a candidate parcel.
Zone 1, Zone 2, Zone 3 and occasional Zone 4 remain distinct and are not converted into a generic parcel score.
Merged public-facing SPZ boundaries remove some internal overlaps and names and are not legal title boundaries.
Groundwater safeguard zones may differ from SPZs and are not treated as duplicate geometry.
Safeguard-zone inclusion does not by itself establish planning refusal, contamination or remediation requirements.
Groundwater vulnerability is not measured contamination, development viability or foundation suitability.
API, WFS, WMS and downloads do not prove an executed candidate overlay or hydrogeological assessment.
No score or promotion is written without exact site geometry, executed overlays and proposal-specific groundwater evidence.
